newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash soybeans up in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash soybeans up in slow trade.

text.p: Argentine soybeans closed higher in slow cash market trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with caution over recently volatile international prices restraining volume, traders said.

FAS elevator soybeans for delivery to Rosario gained $1 to $263. Cash sunflower seed for delivery to Buenos Aires gained $3 to $222, pushed up by patchy buying by a small number of purchasers in thin trade. Cash maize prices were slightly firmer, gaining $1 for delivery to Queuquen to $103 in moderate volume trade. Export demand was muted but local demand took some of the slack.
